title: Consolidate duplicated preview MaterialRegion assignment
description: The editor `CreaturePreviewController.AssignMaterials` and runtime `CreatureRuntimePreview.AssignItemMaterials` independently implement the same presentation mechanics: allocate one Material slot per mesh submesh, seed all slots with a fallback/default material, iterate `GeometryItem.MaterialRegions`, validate each `SubmeshIndex`, resolve the region material, fall back when unresolved, and log a warning on `DomainException`. The material-resolution seams legitimately differ (`Func<string, Material>` in the editor versus `MaterialResolver` in runtime), but the submesh assignment policy is duplicated across two preview adapters. Consolidate only the mechanically shared assignment logic behind a small dependency-injected helper/callback boundary that remains editor/runtime-neutral; do not create a generic preview framework or move palette policy out of `MaterialResolver`. Preserve current fallback and warning behavior, including unresolved explicit material keys.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: Audit evidence 2026-09-11: direct source review confirms materially duplicated `MaterialRegion` assignment loops in `CreaturePreviewController.AssignMaterials` and `CreatureRuntimePreview.AssignItemMaterials`. Existing TSK-0078 owns palette/default-material policy and TSK-0098 owns preview-controller decomposition, but no current task owns this cross-layer mechanical deduplication. No source code was changed during the audit.
